Verses.Text: But Jonah made ready to flee to Tarshish, away from the LORD.
Out of my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me; from the womb of Sheol I cried for help, and you heard my voice.
Then the LORD commanded the fish to vomit Jonah upon dry land.
For I knew that you are a gracious and merciful God, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love, and relenting in punishment.
